1399-11-25 is 1399-11-25.  
124 days earlier:  
1399 has 365 days (non-leap in Jalali? Context says Gregorian).  
1399-11-25 → back 124 days:  
October has 31 days, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (1399 not divisible by 4 → common year), January 31.  
But easier: 124 days before Nov 25:  
Oct 26 is 30 days before Nov 25 (since Oct has 31 days, Oct 26 to Nov 25 = 30 days).  
Need 124 days, so 124 - 30 = 94 days before Oct 26.  
Sept 22 is 34 days before Oct 26 (Sep 22 to Sep 30 = 8 days, Oct 1–26 = 26 days, total 34).  
Need 94 days before Oct 26, so 94 - 34 = 60 days before Sept 22.  
July 24 is 59 days before Sept 22 (July 24 to July 31 = 7 days, August 31 days, Sept 1–22 = 22 days, total 60 days exactly).  
So 60 days before Sept 22 = July 24.  

Thus 124 days before 1399-11-25 = 1399-07-24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1399-07-24
